description: List which inputs and filter values the free tier can use. The free inputs are jobFamilySlug, a location or country, and a company; every result is total compensation from the last 12 months. Dimensions marked free: false (levels, years of experience, focus areas, titles, company size, funding stage, revenue, valuation, work arrangement, offer vs employee) are not accepted by any tool here. Call this before building a query if unsure what a tool accepts.
name: get-available-filters
